title: ExpertLink
summary: Consultation booking platform where clients find consultants, book time slots, pay with Stripe and check in with a QR e-ticket.

contributors.did: Committed the codebase, including the Stripe Checkout integration with verified payments and automatic refunds. Update this with the modules you own.

problem: Finding and booking a professional consultant usually means phone calls and back-and-forth messages, with no clear view of free slots, prices or the consultant's credentials.
solution: A three-role web app for admins, consultants and clients. Consultants set weekly availability and service packages, and show their office on a map. Clients search the directory, pick a slot on an interactive calendar, and pay by card or Stripe; unpaid bookings auto-cancel after 30 minutes and cancellations follow a 24-hour refund policy. Appointments come with a QR e-ticket that the consultant scans to check the client in, and real-time chat and notifications run over SignalR. Security includes cookie auth with role-based access, a self-written captcha, lockout after three failed logins, and token-based email verification and password reset.
outcome: In progress. Add your grade or demo feedback when it's done.
